objective: Discriminate public-binding EndRing interfaces before any further PKE wrapper.

candidates.title: Alternating public-binding proposal/evaluation funnel
candidates.uncertainty: Can a public bare-E relation bind every honest output to one message-preserving preimage class, remain invertible from every complete basis, and support quantitative extraction of a complete ring?
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a reviewed interface candidate and consider a later PKE-design batch; do not call it secure.
candidates.negative_decision: Archive the earliest failed arrow for each exact syntax and keep the goal active without a family-level impossibility claim.
candidates.next_action: Dispatch two mutually blind initial idea generators.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Typed contracts, immutable snapshots, joint-owned reports, raw independence-checker passes, and at most one gap-fed revision.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Name the missing relation, sampler, inverse, equivalence theorem, reconstruction theorem, simulator, or extractor.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Unspecified algorithms remain open; reviewers do not supply them.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Both initial candidates fail at the same exact earliest arrow.

resource_estimate.sharding_plan: Two producers overlap; review owners run under max_concurrent two; archives and compositions run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after revision evaluation or earlier if no decision-changing revision is specifiable.
